scenes.title: 午後的街上，她回頭
scenes.beat_zh: 午後的街上，她走在你旁邊，回頭笑著說今天慢慢來。
scenes.action: The woman stands on a quiet side street in the afternoon, turned toward the right where a small café glows, looking back at the viewer with a relaxed smile.

overlay.caption: 今天就慢慢喝、慢慢聊吧。

video.description: The woman in the first frame, in her cream knit cardigan over a white t-shirt, blue jeans, looks back at the viewer with a relaxed smile. Right away The woman (S1), in a clear, warm voice with a natural Taiwanese Mandarin accent, says: <d>[Chinese] 今天就慢慢喝、慢慢聊吧。</d> Then she tilts her head a little toward the café on the right, still smiling at the viewer, her empty hands relaxed at her sides. continuity: Light only moves forward: afternoon (1-2) -> late afternoon (3-4) -> dusk (5) -> evening (6). Same outfit in every shot: cream cardigan, white t-shirt, jeans. The café window is on the right of the frame in every shot, and she looks, points and leans toward the right. Every shot ends facing the viewer. The coffee cup appears in shots 4-6 and nowhere else. Shot 6's line is shortened from the app's closing line so it fits five seconds.
